subject.title: fix(polls): add default maximum poll option count

question: Should OpenClaw’s Matrix channel silently truncate poll answers beyond 20, reject the request with a clear limit error, or preserve current passthrough behavior until an interoperability policy is approved?
rationale: The protocol cap motivates enforcement, but choosing whether user-supplied answers are dropped, rejected, or passed through is a persistent channel behavior and compatibility policy rather than a mechanically determined repair.

options.title: Adopt builder truncation
options.body: Keep the proposed first-20-answer behavior and document it as the Matrix transport contract after live delivery proof is supplied.

options.title: Reject oversized polls
options.body: Use an explicit Matrix-boundary validation error so no requested poll answers are silently omitted.

options.title: Defer enforcement
options.body: Preserve current behavior until Matrix interoperability expectations and a user-facing failure policy are confirmed.

recommendation.title: Adopt builder truncation
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed first-20-answer behavior and document it as the Matrix transport contract after live delivery proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: They can update the branch and have documented the proposed contract, although a current-main Matrix owner should make the final policy choice.
